summary: Implemented and ran the full compile sweep (a100c/tests/test_compile_sweep.py): one cold pass over the whole corpus through the enabled pipeline (FactoryCompiler, passes=default, isolated temporary artifact cache), enumerating cases exactly as tools/run_scan.py does, compiling each of the 2116 recomputed identities exactly once under a 120s per-identity SIGALRM bound, recompiling every repeat case of an artifact identity as the no-baking control, and recording the compile census to docs/compiler-agent/COMPILE_CENSUS.json. Full run (500 operators, 2734 cases, 2116 identities): 416 artifacts + 1677 located-mostly refusals (57 construct classes) + 22 crashes + 1 over-budget. Economics hold (2053 compiles <= 1.25x2161=2701; 120/120 repeat cases reused one artifact via cache hit; per-pass fired totals prove the enabled pipeline ran), but 23 identities are neither an artifact nor a located refusal and 141 of 1677 refusals carry no source location, so acceptance[0] and acceptance[2] do not hold -- the census is the recorded repair backlog, never a pass and never a narrowed corpus. Both violations are compiler defects outside this task's allowed write path (a100c/tests/test_compile_sweep.py only): the LICM pass crashes on 6 identities, an AttributeError on MaskType.sew crashes 15 more, an OverflowError crashes 1, and three refusal sites raise without a location (driver._load_source autotune unwrap 63, lower/vectorize.py:1055 67, allocation/const 11).
